case_scope: United States fissured workplace and joint employer responsibility

workplace_power_gate.note: Alternative work arrangements, proposed contractor classification changes, and joint-employer rollback/uncertainty make responsibility/control separation a live current-law problem.

misclassification_risk.note: Classification rules are volatile; employee status must be scored as a claim-conversion threshold for wages, overtime, leave, insurance, bargaining, and retaliation remedies.

joint_employer_responsibility.note: The NLRB 2023 joint-employer rule was withdrawn and DOL joint-employer standards remain in rulemaking; lead-firm accountability cannot be assumed.

fissured_workplace_accountability.note: Certification requires evidence that liability follows actual control in franchise, staffing, contractor, platform, and subcontract chains.

temporary_contingent_work_security.note: Contingent and alternative arrangements require separate scoring for benefit access, scheduling risk, unemployment insurance, and claim enforceability.

proof_debt: sectoral subcontracting and franchise chain maps
classification and joint-employer rule status by statute
wage theft and injury remedy recovery by tier
responsible-party asset adequacy and collection rates

gate_14_workplace_power.why: Where economic control and legal responsibility diverge, wages and remedies are not claimable without joint-responsibility proof.

gate_11_enforcement.why: Enforcement must identify and reach the entity with actual control and assets, not merely the nominal employer.

evidence_debt_register.question: sectoral subcontracting and franchise chain maps
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map control and liability layers in franchise, staffing, logistics, care, construction, hospitality, platform, and janitorial sectors.

evidence_debt_register.question: classification and joint-employer rule status by statute
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track DOL independent-contractor rulemaking, DOL joint-employer rulemaking, and NLRB joint-employer standard separately.

evidence_debt_register.question: lead-firm contractual control evidence
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect contracts showing control over pay, scheduling, discipline, metrics, technology, uniforms, pricing, staffing, and termination.

evidence_debt_register.question: wage theft and injury recovery by tier
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether workers recover from the economically controlling entity or only nominal intermediaries.

evidence_debt_register.question: responsible-party asset adequacy
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Determine whether the liable entity has enough assets/insurance to satisfy judgments and settlements.

policy_pathway: Separate contractor classification, joint-employer liability, and lead-firm control as three different current-law proof burdens.
Show that workers can reach the controlling entity fast enough for wages, benefits, retaliation, bargaining, and safety remedies.
